A.notes: A has a coherent quiet idea: warm brick tones, courtyard motifs, large calm typography, and every project pairs an image with a readable plan. The work is clean and accessible, but the structure is fairly conventional and the scroll-frame strip shows little motion beyond standard page movement, so the experience feels more static than authored.

B.notes: B has the stronger signature: drawing-grid plans, brick textures, numbered chronology, and a more architectural editorial system make it feel specific to the brief. Typography is excellent, and the motion version appears to stage content in sequence, but the standard first screen is too empty and less successful than the reduced-motion fallback, which hurts craft and clarity.

raw.why: B establishes a more distinctive architectural identity and diagram language, even though its motion-led hero is less resolved than A’s steadier presentation.
